name: Git Extended
description: Git workflow extensions: gcr/gwr checkout and worktree commands, plus pm_detect which updates dependencies for every package manager found in the repository

installGcrFunction.description: Install the gcr (Git Checkout Remote) command

installGwrFunction.description: Install the gwr (Git Worktree Remote) command

pkgManager.description: Comma-separated managers pm_detect may run (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, dotnet, composer, bundle, cargo). Unset = detect automatically.

worktreePath.description: Directory where gwr creates worktrees. Relative paths resolve against the current directory; unset = .worktrees in the current directory.
